calls.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'for f in $(rg -l --glob '"'src/main/**/*.java' '\\bJsonNode\\b' src/main); do rg -n '\\.get\\s*\\(' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/zsh -lc "for t in JsonNode ArrayNode ObjectNode ContainerNode BaseJsonNode ValueNode; do rg -l --glob 'src/main/**/*.java' \"\\\\b"'${t}'"\\\\b\" src/main; done | sort -u | while read f; do if rg -q '\\.get\\s*\\(' \""'$f"; then echo "$f"; rg -n '"'\\.get\\s*\\(' \""'$f"; fi; done'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '150,245p' src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/JsonNode.java
sed -n '1,100p' src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/node/ContainerNode.java
sed -n '235,300p' src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/node/ArrayNode.java
sed -n '250,295p' src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/node/ObjectNode.java
sed -n '45,85p' src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/node/ValueNode.java
rg -n --glob 'src/main/**/*.java' 'get\\s*\\(\\s*(final\\s+)?int\\s+' src/main"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n --glob 'src/main/**/*.java' '\\.get\\s*\\(' src/main | wc -l
rg -n --glob 'src/main/**/*.java' '\\.get\\s*\\(\\s*(\\(["'^)]+'"\\)\\s*)?[-+0-9]' src/main
rg -n --glob 'src/main/**/*.java' '(readTree|valueToTree|createArrayNode|arrayNode|withArray|path|required|at)\\s*\\(["'^;]*'"\\)\\s*\\.get\\s*\\(' src/main
rg -n --glob 'src/main/**/*.java' '\\b(get|path|required|at)\\(["'^;]*'"\\)\\.get\\s*\\(' src/main"
